instructions: Add the books/articles you trust as starting points. Grok Bot does not add seeds. Each seed: doi, or openalex (W...), or title + author (+ year). Optional: topics (e.g. ["Kimolos", "piracy"]) to group seeds per research question. tools/citation_snowball.py follows their references (backward) and the works that cite them (forward) via OpenAlex, with Semantic Scholar as fallback. A seed that cannot be matched exactly is reported UNRESOLVED, never guessed.
